content.question: Why does the Transformer need positional encoding?
options: Because the dot products in attention would otherwise fail to detect which tokens are similar to each other.
Because it processes all tokens in parallel with no built-in notion of order, so position information must be injected.
Because sinusoidal values generalize better than learned embeddings when the model encounters longer sequences at test time.
Because the layer normalization inside each block would otherwise become unstable without position-aware statistics.
Because cross-attention requires the decoder inputs to be aligned with the encoder inputs position by position.
content.answer: Because it processes all tokens in parallel with no built-in notion of order, so position information must be injected.
